4\. Other processes can read the fire token 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
fire() embeds the bearer token in the curl argument vector rather than passing it through a
protected input channel. On a host where another local process can inspect process arguments during
the request, that process can copy the credential used to fire the project's lead task.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The fire token appears in curl's process arguments during every request, despite being scrubbed from printed output. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[3626-3641] ## Recommended Fix Pass the authorization header to curl through a protected stdin-fed configuration or another mechanism that does not place the token in the command-line arguments. Preserve output and error scrubbing. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
